t: This is Orchard House, a Neo-Classical building in London. Neo-Classical means a style drawing on the orderly forms of ancient Greece and Rome, so look for that kind of balance and restraint in the front. Two British architects designed it. Alfred Frederick Aldridge Trehearne lived from 1874 to 1962, and Charles Frederick Norman lived from 1884 to 1925. Norman died the younger of the two, so the building may well belong to the earlier part of their careers.
